description: Input: the same fields as quote_analysis. Break down any reel or ad into a reference_profile: the spoken words with timing, hook, beats, graphics, captions, pacing, voice, top comments and the funnel code word; mode "data" answers only the data: words, scenes between cuts, hook and a frame a second. Pass asset_id of an MP4 asset up to 100 MiB, or source_url of an Instagram reel or post or a TikTok video. Both modes read reels up to 180 s (an asset that is not analysis_only, 120 s); a longer one is refused at no charge. A YouTube link is refused: upload its MP4 with create_asset. Full is priced by the reel's length; a link of unknown length holds the most and is charged by the length. Charged once it succeeds; a failed analysis costs nothing. 10 new full and 60 new data analyses per hour. The same asset or full link in the same mode answers the same analysis free unless it failed; one made before frames and speakers existed is redone free once. Poll get_reference_analysis with wait_seconds: 50. Price: 37 to 72 credits by the reel's length, 66 to 134 from 2026-12-01; data mode: 10 credits per call. Quote first with quote_analysis.
name: analyze_reference
title: Analyse a reference ad
